people.name: Javan
people.line: Son of Japheth; ancestor of Greek people

translations.web: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.
translations.bsb: What then? Are we any better? Not at all. For we have already made the charge that Jews and Greeks alike are all under sin.
translations.kjv: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
translations.asv: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we before laid to the charge both of Jews and Greeks, that they are all under sin;
